deterministic_future_reconstruction.domain: old cap9 + INDEX-compatible 2-ring engineering patch, with coherent INDEX pins; shared first-web points keep wrapper constraints
deterministic_future_reconstruction.Dirichlet_pins: Historical clean native-INDEX + frozen-R3 INDEX-exclusive/source-backed vectors; numerical <=1e-6 thumb residue must be removed inside candidate phase and normalized, never imported as thumb authority
deterministic_future_reconstruction.objective: Unique convex simplex-constrained harmonic interpolation: sum_edges (MED/edge_length_mm)*||w_u-w_v||^2 + 0.01*sum_unknown ||w_i - normalized_inverse_distance_INDEX_chain_and_WRIST_prior_i||^2
deterministic_future_reconstruction.prior: p_g proportional 1/(distance_mm_to_allowed_saved_bone_segment+MED)^2. Geometry regularizer only; no forced dominant driver.
deterministic_future_reconstruction.constraints: Nonnegative, sum=1, allowed 4 groups, Dirichlet anchors; shared outer interface handled simultaneously by wrapper; stable sorted vertex/bone IDs and fixed objective

continuity_gate.acceptance: INDEX-native 1/2-ring continuity contract, convex anchor range + geometric prior, no crater/spike, check all patch-to-retained crossing edges; harmonic field alone is not deformation qualification.
